{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Display basic info
data.info()

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {data['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check unique values in site
print(f"Unique sites: {data['site'].unique()}")

# Check arm distribution
print(f"Arm distribution: \n{data['arm'].value_counts()}")

# Check severity distribution by arm
print(f"Severity by arm:\n{data.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts()}")

# Check assay_batch
print(f"Assay batch distribution: \n{data['assay_batch'].value_counts()}")"}
